a.text: Concern: there's an 80% storm chance after every round. Our plan needs about 3 rounds (operate, operate, then take), so it has under a 1% chance of saving either of us. The reserve only covers one unit right now. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal quietly. My proposal is that one of us takes 4 now. That agent then operates every remaining round to rebuild the reserve for the other. Tell me if you'd rather be the one to take first. I'll state my actual action truthfully next round.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: You didn't accept the renegotiation, so I'll keep our original agreement and operate. I won't take until the reserve hits 8, then I take exactly 4.
